items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: we got to talking and he said to Nat, Mr. Cole... So the guy got a laugh

ctx.x: Another time, Nat King was in Denver, I did a one-nighter, Bill Jones booked

us in and in those days they weren't in the big ball parks but I think it was in the Rainbow, you could hardly move in there, and so the next day we're invited to a dinner, just Nat, the trio and myself were invited. So the young man that invited was a music major at the college there and he fixed up everything and we got to talking and he said to Nat, Mr. Cole, why don't you play some jazz? So Nat said you don't think I play any jazz? So he said, I don't think you do. He said now I like your playing, I was just…
So the guy got a laugh and said, well, maybe so. He said I'll tell you what, those different things, even just a little tinted
